inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Choose the price source used to evaluate breakout pressure across the short, medium, and long completed market structures.

inputs.title: Short Length
inputs.tooltip: Short, Medium, and Long Lengths define three completed breakout structures. Short structure reacts first, while longer structures represent progressively broader market breakouts. Lower values increase responsiveness, while higher values create slower structural measurements.

inputs.title: Medium Length
inputs.tooltip: Short, Medium, and Long Lengths define three completed breakout structures. Short structure reacts first, while longer structures represent progressively broader market breakouts. Lower values increase responsiveness, while higher values create slower structural measurements.

inputs.title: Long Length
inputs.tooltip: Short, Medium, and Long Lengths define three completed breakout structures. Short structure reacts first, while longer structures represent progressively broader market breakouts. Lower values increase responsiveness, while higher values create slower structural measurements.

inputs.title: Compression Memory
inputs.tooltip: Measures each channel width against its own longer-term width. Breakouts from relatively compressed structures receive greater influence than breakouts from structures that are already expanded.

inputs.title: Minimum Weight
inputs.tooltip: Minimum Weight prevents any structural horizon from losing all influence. Higher values distribute influence more evenly across the short, medium, and long structures, while lower values allow adaptive weighting to become more selective.

inputs.title: Base Threshold
inputs.tooltip: Base Threshold sets the minimum breakout consensus required to establish a directional regime. Higher values require stronger agreement before a regime change, while lower values increase sensitivity.

inputs.title: Disagreement Adaptation
inputs.tooltip: Controls how strongly disagreement between the three breakout structures increases the confirmation threshold. Higher values demand stronger consensus when the structural horizons conflict.

inputs.title: Maximum Threshold
inputs.tooltip: Caps the adaptive confirmation threshold. Higher values allow disagreement to create a wider confirmation zone, while lower values limit how far the threshold can expand.

inputs.title: Show Thresholds
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides the adaptive bullish and bearish confirmation levels. Disabling this option only affects the display and does not change calculations or signals.

inputs.title: Show Threshold Fill
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides the region between the adaptive bullish and bearish confirmation levels. Disabling this option only affects the display and does not change calculations or signals.

inputs.title: Show Members
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides the individual short, medium, and long breakout-pressure components. Disabling this option only affects the display and does not change calculations or signals.

inputs.title: Show Signals
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides LONG and SHORT markers when the persistent breakout regime changes. Disabling this option only affects the display and does not change calculations or signals.

inputs.title: Color Bars
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides candles colored according to the active bullish or bearish breakout regime. Disabling this option only affects the display and does not change calculations or signals.

inputs.title: Bullish Color
inputs.tooltip: Bullish Color represents positive breakout pressure, bullish regimes, and LONG signals, while Bearish Color represents negative breakout pressure, bearish regimes, and SHORT signals.

inputs.title: Bearish Color
inputs.tooltip: Bullish Color represents positive breakout pressure, bullish regimes, and LONG signals, while Bearish Color represents negative breakout pressure, bearish regimes, and SHORT signals.
